newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B index up on rally in local shares.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B index up on rally in local shares.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed slightly higher on Thursday on a rally in Shenzhen-based counters and the A market rebounded to a record high, brokers said.
The B share index inched up 0.03 points to 91.19, but turnover fell to HK$15.26 million from HK$19.62 million on Wednesday.
The A market rebounded strongly, with the index gaining 13.85 points, or 3.62 percent, to close at a record 397.85.

Brokers said the B index rise was due in part to gains by local shares, which were among Wednesday's biggest losers. But trading remained sluggish due to a lack of institutional participation, they said.
With the year-end approaching, some investors were building positions in issues likely to report healthy 1996 results, one analyst said.

Fangda, which implemented a four-for-10 scrip payout as its 1996 interim dividend on Wednesday, ended Thursday at HK$4.52 on the session's second heaviest trade of 428,600 shares. On Wednesday, the issue closed at HK$5.99.
The counter's price reflected investor optimism over the firm's earnings this year, brokers said.
Tsann Kuen was the star, rising HK$0.25 or 11.36 percent to HK$2.45, in thin volume of 21,060 shares.
Shenzhen Properties, which fell sharply on Wednesday, rebounded HK$0.23, or 9.20 percent, to HK$2.73 in trade of 69,613 shares.
Chiwan Petroleum was the biggest loser, falling HK$0.25, or 6.94 percent, to HK$3.35, with 112,200 shares changing hands.
Motorcycle producer North Jianshe slipped HK$0.10 to HK$2.20 in trading of 255,000 shares. Brokers said there was market talk that the company's operations were poor this year.
Dadonghai traded the most on volume of 1.32 million shares and fell HK$0.03 to HK$1.32.
On the A share market, turnover was 13.23 billion yuan compared with the previous session's 11.74 billion. The composite index climbed 12.49 points, or 3.49 percent, to 370.06.
Transport firm Anda was the star on speculative demand, brokers said. The counter surged 1.61 yuan, or 19.61 percent, to 9.82 yuan.
Floppy disk maker Huayuan followed suit, soaring 1.52 yuan, or 17.18 percent, to 10.37 yuan.
